benjamin-franklin-t-shirt.description: Heather gray short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt featuring the Benjamin Franklin College shield in red and blue with white lightning bolts and fleurs-de-lis, with BENJAMIN FRANKLIN COLLEGE printed in black beneath.

berkeley-sweater-fleece-jacket.description: Light heather gray full-zip sweater fleece jacket with a stand collar, charcoal zipper and pocket trim, zippered hand pockets, and an embroidered red Berkeley College shield with BERKELEY text on the left chest.

timothy-dwight-college-crewneck.description: Heather gray long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband, featuring a small red Timothy Dwight College shield and TIMOTHY DWIGHT text on the left chest.
